phases.name: Stabilise
phases.description: P0 fixes, sync rebuild, security rotation, KT package.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Messages, Rejected loop, Transactions list, Feedback chat, Sakhi dashboard, Sync.

phases.name: Workflow
phases.description: Attendance, Best Activities, Bulk onboarding, Approval window, Training Records, Reports.

phases.name: Sakhi & Beneficiary
phases.description: My Budget, Beneficiary Receipts, Badges, Training Videos.

phases.name: Strategic
phases.description: SHG/Cluster modelling, Programme Mgmt cockpit, SROI, Data archive.

screens.title: Sakhi Home with Rejected Transactions card
screens.purpose: Make the rejected transactions visible to the Sakhi on her home screen, with reason and Take Action CTA. Convergent fix for I-5 + SA-4.
features: New Rejected Transactions card on home, below Transaction Details
Counter strip on Transaction Details: Approved (5) / Pending (10) / Rejected (2)
Latest 3 rejections with reason snippet + Take Action link
Tap row → opens rejection detail with edit + resubmit
lookAndFeel: 4px left border in danger red for scanability
Status pills use the three-colour grammar (green/yellow/red)
Material Symbols Rounded icons throughout

screens.title: Sakhi Dashboard — tabular layout
screens.purpose: Replace chart-heavy dashboard with tabular layouts the field can read at a glance. Strong rural-UX win.
features: Income card (renamed from Remuneration) with Schemes/Services filter + date range
Awareness card with beneficiary count + date range
Overall Transaction Status — 3-col table (S.No / Type / Number)
Best Performing + Worst Performing — 3-col tables (S.No / Name / Income)
Target Status — 2-col table (Target / Achieved) with month picker
lookAndFeel: Tables preferred over charts (literacy-aware)
Only one chart kept — Income bar — because money over time is intuitive
Filter chips above each card, lightweight

screens.title: Sakhi Transactions list — new filters + columns
screens.purpose: Optimise the workhorse screen. Default list = last 2 months approved/rejected + all pending. Multi-choice filters. Beneficiary filter. New Remuneration + Evidence columns.
features: Default window: last 2 months approved/rejected + all pending
Multi-choice filter chips: District, Block, Scheme, Purpose, FO, Status
Beneficiary autocomplete (keyed by mobile number)
New columns: Remuneration ₹, Evidence thumbnail (click to enlarge)
Last refreshed badge top-right
lookAndFeel: Filter chips wrap, Reset link to clear all
Evidence thumbnails 32×32 with click-to-enlarge
Status pills standardised across roles
assumptions: Status pill copy unified across roles (resolves drift between Admin/NGO variants)

screens.title: Messages — Compose (NGO admin)
screens.purpose: NGO admin broadcasts to FOs and/or Sakhis. Convergent module for NGO-7 + NGO-10 + FO-3 + CR-3.
features: Recipient role tabs: FOs / Sakhis
Multi-select checklist of recipients with search + select-all-in-district
Compose pane: 200-word body with live counter, photo attachment
Send / Save draft / Delete actions
Schedule send option
lookAndFeel: Familiar email-compose pattern for trust
Photo-only attachments (narrower than original SOW per Dhwani feedback 2)
assumptions: C-1: NGO Admin → Sakhi messaging is included (recommended). Flag visible on canvas.
screens.existingReference: New module — no existing equivalent in admin

screens.title: Messages — Inbox (Sakhi)
screens.purpose: Sakhi reads broadcasts from FO and NGO admin in one inbox.
features: Tile below Training Kit on home (label: Messages)
Two tabs: All / Unread
Sender badge clearly distinguishes FO vs NGO Admin
Photo preview thumbnail when attached
Unread bold; tap to mark read
lookAndFeel: Card-row layout, 64px row height for easy thumb tap
Sender name + role badge on every row
assumptions: C-1: includes NGO Admin sender role

screens.title: Mark Attendance (FO)
screens.purpose: FO marks today's attendance with one tap. Location is captured on submit.
features: Mark Attendance action top-right of FO home
Location permission prompt before submit
After mark: state changes to 'Marked at HH:MM, Village X', disabled
Toast confirmation with location pin
lookAndFeel: One-tap action — fewest possible steps
Clear today-only constraint communicated in copy
Location consent explicit, not implicit
assumptions: No back-fill (today-only). No leave flow at v1.
screens.existingReference: New top-right action; integrates with existing FO home from 03_ui_inventory.md §2.7

screens.title: Bulk Sakhi Onboarding — Step 1: Scope
screens.purpose: NGO admin onboards Sakhis in bulk via templated CSV. Replaces the FO's mobile create-Sakhi path (NGO-5).
features: 4-step stepper: Scope → Download Template → Upload CSV → Validate → Commit
Step 1: State / District / Block / FO autocompletes (cascading)
Geo-scoped — NGO sees only assigned states/districts
Village master sheet linked alongside template download
lookAndFeel: Stepper communicates progress and irreversibility
Each step clearly bounded — no skipping
Validation results inline with row-level errors
assumptions: C-3: migration plan — mobile FO Create Sakhi removed and replaced with Messages-request pattern

screens.title: My Budget — Sakhi personal finance
screens.purpose: Sakhi tracks her own monthly income (auto-Mein-Pragati + manual) and expenses. Computes savings.
features: Tile beside Dashboard / Beneficiary Details on home
Month tabs: This Month / Last Month / This Year
Three summary cards: Income / Expense / Savings
Day-wise list grouped by date
Add entry FAB → Income or Expense
lookAndFeel: No charts — simple totals + day-wise list per SOW
Income from Mein Pragati auto-tagged
Plus/minus colour grammar (green for in, red for out)
assumptions: Category list shown is placeholder — pending Biswajit. Flag visible on canvas.

screens.title: Beneficiary Receipt — printable template
screens.purpose: Auto-generated receipt for the beneficiary after each approved transaction. Tangible artefact in her language.
features: A6-sized printable layout (1 receipt per page)
Mein Pragati + CRISIL Foundation header
Beneficiary name + father/husband + village
Transaction date + scheme/service + amount
Sakhi name + signature line
QR code linking to verification page
Localised in beneficiary language (Hindi shown as sample)
lookAndFeel: Print-optimised — simple structure, large readable typography
Suitable for thermal printing if a Sakhi has access to a Bluetooth printer
PDF download and SMS-share also available from the same template
assumptions: Q-2: Wireframe builds printable + SMS link + IVR-readable text. Three channels, one template.

screens.title: SHG entity list — admin
screens.purpose: Promote SHG to a first-class entity. Replaces the free-text instritution_name column. Unlocks A-B3/A-B4/A-B5 (SHG-SRLM, SHG-RF, SHG-VO).
features: New 'SHGs' module in sidebar
Table: SHG Name / Village / Federation/VO / Members / Sakhi / SRLM linked / RF received / Resilience avg
Status pills for SRLM/RF (linked vs not)
Filter strip with multi-choice geo + linkage status
Action: View detail, Edit, Merge (for duplicates from migration)
lookAndFeel: Standard admin table with the new SHG-specific columns
Resilience score uses the existing colour band
Migration banner visible until legacy free-text data is reconciled
assumptions: Q-1: Cluster modelled separately from Centre

screens.title: Programme Management cockpit (CRISIL admin)
screens.purpose: Multi-NGO partner cockpit. Surfaces existing MoU / Phase / Target tables as a coherent project-management view.
features: Landing KPIs: Total IPs / Active MoUs / Disbursed YTD / Milestones on-track vs at-risk
Milestone Achievement heatmap (rows = IPs, cols = milestones, cell = status)
Activity Timeline (Gantt-style) per IP
Tranche Release & Disbursement tracker
Per-IP drilldown
lookAndFeel: Heatmap is the signature view — quick visual scan of partner health
Status colour grammar consistent: green = on-track, yellow = at-risk, red = missed
Top filters: NGO, Geography, Period
screens.existingReference: New module — surfaces existing mou, mou_phase_mapper, mou_target, milestone, target tables

screens.title: Sakhi Today's Plan home (action centre)
screens.purpose: Aggregate every pending action a Sakhi has into a prioritised list. Net-new Dhwani-proposed home screen.
features: Hero card: 'You have 8 things to do today'
Urgent section: rejected transactions (with 'Take Action')
Pending submissions counter
FHC counselling due
Unread messages aggregated
Suggested today (data quality nudges)
Window-closing banner
Online + sync queue strip at top
Quick-capture FAB menu (Transaction / Beneficiary / Linkage / FHC)
lookAndFeel: Brand-red hero with action count
Severity-coded section borders (red urgent, amber soon, brand normal, grey gentle)
Each task row has a clear 'why this matters' sub-line
assumptions: Replaces current tile-grid home — needs A/B with field
screens.existingReference: Today: 03_ui_inventory.md §2.7 Home Screen is a tile grid + banner carousel. Today's Plan replaces or augments it.

screens.title: Sakhi/FO Sync queue with retry
screens.purpose: Show exactly which records are queued, uploading, or failed. Retry individual records. Replaces the opaque 'syncing...' screen and removes the cache-clear workaround.
features: Hero status: connected / pending count / last sync time
Tabs: To server · From server · History
Sections: Uploading now · Queued · Failed (with retry button)
Per-record progress bars
Bottom actions: Sync now · Force full re-sync
lookAndFeel: Brand-red hero with pulsing online dot
Clear status colour per row (info=uploading, neutral=queued, danger=failed, success=done)
Helper text below failed: 'Retries every 5 min automatically'
screens.existingReference: Today: sync is a Lottie animation with a single status string. No record-level visibility.

screens.title: FO — Create Sakhi removed (banner)
screens.purpose: Soft-landing communication for FOs whose ability to create Sakhis from mobile has been moved to the NGO admin web flow. Sakhi onboarding now sits with the NGO admin.

screens.title: Sakhi — Create transaction (window-aware)
screens.purpose: Create-transaction form with date picker that visibly greys out dates outside the 15-day approval window for the current cycle. A banner explains the window state and time remaining.

screens.title: Sakhi — Window closing banner
screens.purpose: Home banner that shows the days remaining in the current 15-day approval window. Becomes more urgent as cutoff approaches.

screens.title: FO — Training Records list
screens.purpose: FO views past monthly training sessions she submitted, with approval status from NGO admin. Tile to add a new session.

screens.title: FO — Add training record
screens.purpose: FO captures the details of a monthly training session she conducted: date, agenda, participants, photos. Submitted to NGO admin for approval.

screens.title: NGO — Training Records approval queue
screens.purpose: NGO admin queue of FO training sessions awaiting review. Each row has FO, topic, photos, attendance, date and inline approve/reject.

screens.title: FO — Active Sakhis (monthly view)
screens.purpose: FO sees her assigned Sakhis with January counts: linkages, awareness, transactions. Month picker at the top. Tap to drill into individual Sakhi performance.

screens.title: Reports — FO tab (new)
screens.purpose: Reports module gains a new FO tab parallel to Sakhi. Shows per-FO aggregate metrics with the same period selector applied to monthly/quarterly/half-yearly.

screens.title: Reports — User Dump download
screens.purpose: CSV export of user roster for HR / audit / capacity-planning. Admin picks scope (state/district/block/role/active status) then downloads.

screens.title: Photo evidence quality check — concept
screens.purpose: On-device quality check on every evidence photo before it leaves the device. Catches blur, darkness, low resolution. Forces a retake instead of getting rejected later.

screens.title: Saved filter presets
screens.purpose: A management screen for the saved filter presets that show up in the Transactions filter drawer. Reorder, rename, delete, share with team.

screens.title: My Budget — Add income
screens.purpose: Quick income entry. Choose date, source, category, amount. Mein Pragati earnings are auto-pulled — manual entry is for other income (e.g. tailoring, dairy, gifts).

screens.title: My Budget — Add expense
screens.purpose: Quick expense entry. Pick a category from icons, enter amount and a note. Categories shown are a placeholder — final list pending from Biswajit.

screens.title: My Budget — Month summary
screens.purpose: End-of-month roll-up. Shows total in, total out, savings, category breakdown. Simple table — no charts per SOW.

screens.title: Sakhi — Generate receipt (after approval)
screens.purpose: After NGO approval, the Sakhi sees a "Generate Receipt" CTA on the approved transaction. Shows beneficiary, transaction details, and lets her pick a delivery channel.

screens.title: FO — Badges & leaderboard
screens.purpose: FO sees badges they have earned and a state-internal leaderboard. Refreshed monthly on the 5th from previous-month performance.

screens.title: Admin — Badge criteria configuration
screens.purpose: Admin defines the badge taxonomy. Each badge has a name, a criteria expression, a recipient type (FO or Sakhi), a refresh schedule, a visibility scope.

screens.title: Training Kit — videos (mobile)
screens.purpose: Sakhi/FO Training Kit extended with video content. Card grid mixes PDF cards (existing) and video cards (new — with play icon + duration).

screens.title: Admin — Upload training video
screens.purpose: Admin uploads a training video, picks the scheme/state, attaches caption files for each supported language, and publishes to the field.

screens.title: Profile completion meter — concept
screens.purpose: Track completeness of Sakhi and FO profiles (GSE date, exam cert, photo, batch year, etc.). Surfacing gaps gives admin a data-hygiene lever without nagging.

screens.title: SHG detail — Manalisha SHG
screens.purpose: Full SHG profile. Replaces the free-text institution name with structured fields: federation/VO, SRLM linkage, RF receipt, member list, assigned Sakhi.

screens.title: Cluster list (admin)
screens.purpose: Cluster modelling (separate from Centre — Q-1 in implementation plan). Shows clusters with their FO and member count.

screens.title: SHG migration tool — free-text → entity
screens.purpose: One-time admin utility to resolve legacy free-text "institution_name" values into formal SHG entities. Fuzzy-matches with confidence score; admin confirms or rejects each match.

screens.title: Tranche release tracker
screens.purpose: Detailed tranche tracker per IP. Shows planned schedule, released amounts, due dates, late warnings.

screens.title: Social Value dashboard (SROI)
screens.purpose: SROI dashboard. Shows total social value created across geographies, NGOs, time. Tied to the coefficient master defined separately.

screens.title: SROI coefficient master
screens.purpose: Admin maintains the coefficient table that feeds the SROI dashboard. Each scheme has a coefficient, a source, a last-updated date.

screens.title: Sakhi — Social value card
screens.purpose: Motivational view for the Sakhi: how much social value her own approved linkages have created. Personal, in her language.

screens.title: Dashboard — new KPI cards
screens.purpose: The main admin dashboard with the new KPI cards added from CR-4, CR-9, CR-10, A-B1, A-B2. Visually communicates which cards are net-new vs preserved from the current dashboard.

screens.title: Data archive — request
screens.purpose: Admin requests a year of transactions to be archived. The data remains queryable on-demand but no longer slows down live dashboards.

screens.title: Audit trail viewer
screens.purpose: Searchable audit log of all field-level edits across the system. Filter by entity type, user, date range, action. Click any row for before/after diff.

screens.title: Sakhi — Badges & leaderboard
screens.purpose: Sakhi-side version of the badge gallery. Sees her own state-internal leaderboard ranking + her own earned badges.

screens.title: Beneficiary form — SHG dropdown (new)
screens.purpose: The Sakhi's add-beneficiary form now references SHG as a real entity. Replaces the free-text "Institution name" with a structured search-select.

screens.title: Sakhi: Rejected detail (edit+resubmit)
screens.purpose: Sakhi opens a rejected transaction, sees the FO/NGO reason in a red banner, edits the flagged field (typically evidence photo), and resubmits — the approval chain is NOT reset.

screens.title: FO: Action-Taken tracking view
screens.purpose: FO sees rejections she has raised against her Sakhis, with action status: awaiting Sakhi, resubmitted, window expired. Counter strip at top.

screens.title: Admin/NGO: Rejected & Action-Taken module
screens.purpose: Web admin dashboard for all rejected transactions across the NGO, with reason, status, and age. Convergent fix for CR-8 + FO-8.

screens.title: Sakhi: All rejected list
screens.purpose: Sakhi sees every rejection she has + their action status. Tap any to open the fix-and-resubmit detail screen.

screens.title: Admin: Notification matrix
screens.purpose: Admin manages which events trigger which channels (push/SMS/email/IVR) for each role. Visible flag on the placeholder event list.

screens.title: Sakhi: Notifications (aggregated)
screens.purpose: Sakhi notifications inbox — aggregated by type (not per-record). Per rural-UX recommendation to avoid notification storms.

screens.title: Messages: Sent history (NGO)
screens.purpose: NGO sees past broadcasts, who they went to, read percentages. Edit/delete actions per row.

screens.title: Messages: Admin view-only
screens.purpose: CRISIL admin sees every broadcast from every NGO. View-only — no compose / edit. Filter by NGO.

screens.title: FO: Messages inbox
screens.purpose: FO inbox with Received and Sent tabs. Forward-to-my-Sakhis is a primary action.

screens.title: FO: Message detail
screens.purpose: FO reads an NGO broadcast in full. Can mark unread or forward to assigned Sakhis.

screens.title: FO: Compose message (to Sakhis)
screens.purpose: FO writes a broadcast for all her assigned Sakhis. 200-word limit, one photo, optional subject. Voice-input shortcut.

screens.title: Sakhi: Message detail
screens.purpose: Sakhi reads a broadcast with sender info, body, attachments. Read receipt back to sender. Replies disabled (broadcast — use Feedback for chat).

screens.title: Transactions: Filter drawer
screens.purpose: Multi-select filter drawer for Sakhi Transactions list. District/Block/Scheme/Status multi-pills, date range, beneficiary search, saved presets.

screens.title: Feedback chat (Read/Action-taken/Pending)
screens.purpose: NGO chat with Sakhis and FOs. Each message has sender name + timestamp + status (Read / Action Taken / Pending) that the admin updates inline.

screens.title: Feedback list (with status column)
screens.purpose: Roll-up view of all feedback threads with status, sender role, last update by. KPI cards for pending vs action-taken counts.

screens.title: Voice-to-text on remarks (concept)
screens.purpose: On-device speech-to-text in Hindi/Assamese on any free-text field. Recording sheet with live transcript and audio visualisation.

screens.title: Attendance: FO list (NGO web)
screens.purpose: NGO admin sees all FOs with attendance %, days present this month, last marked. Below-80% FOs flagged.

screens.title: Attendance: Per-FO calendar
screens.purpose: Month grid per FO. Each cell shows Present / Absent / Off with marked timestamp. Click a day for location and device detail.

screens.title: FO: Best Activities list
screens.purpose: FO views her own uploaded Best Activities (stories + photos of standout work by her Sakhis).

screens.title: FO: Add Best Activity
screens.purpose: Photo + title + 500-word story + optional Sakhi/Beneficiary tag. Auto-attaches location. Voice-input shortcut available.

screens.title: Admin gallery (Best Activities)
screens.purpose: Admin sees all activities as a card gallery. Filter by region, date, FO. Download for case studies.

screens.title: Bulk Sakhi — Step 2 Download & Upload
screens.purpose: NGO admin downloads the templated CSV (pre-filled with scope) + village master sheet, fills the data offline, then drops the file back to upload.

screens.title: Bulk Sakhi — Step 3 Validate
screens.purpose: Server validates the uploaded CSV row by row. Pass / Warn / Fail per row with inline error message. Bulk fixes for common patterns.

roleGroups.description: Supervisor on the ground — mobile only

roleGroups.name: NGO Partner
roleGroups.description: SeSTA, RGVN, RBKS, GVT, Grameen Sahara — web admin
